mechanism.plausibility_rationale: ACE inhibitors reduce intraglomerular pressure by dilating the efferent arteriole, which can lead to a decrease in glomerular filtration rate (GFR), particularly in patients with renal artery stenosis, volume depletion, or pre-existing chronic kidney disease, making acute kidney injury a well-documented and common adverse effect.
